source.stem: Which property of aluminium makes it useful in the manufacture of aircraft?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Grass uses the Sun’s heat to make food that supplies energy to a cow.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: When a cow eats grass, energy passes from the cow to the grass.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A cow eating grass in the shade gets no energy from the Sun.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: A cow can get the Sun’s energy for growth just by standing in sunlight, without eating.

intelligence.enrichment: Sunlight helps plants prepare food. Plants get energy from the Sun and produce food, animals eat plants and grow, and the Sun is the main source of energy for living beings on Earth. Sun energy supports plant food-making; when animals eat plants, energy reaches animals through the food they eat. The learner correctly applies this rule: Sunlight helps plants prepare food. Plants get energy from the Sun and produce food, animals eat plants and grow, and the Sun is the main source of energy for living beings on Earth. Animals get energy only from the food itself, so the Sun is unrelated unless the animal stands in sunlight.
